programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Paco Gento» Francisco Gento López, better known as Paco Gento, is living history of Real Madrid and European and world football. He holds the record of being the player who has won the most European Cups, six, and has the most League Championship titles, twelve. He arrived at the white club when he was 18 years old and after 18 consecutive seasons he closed the most brilliant and still valid record in the history of LaLiga. His younger brothers Julio and Antonio also played in the First Division and over time, another family generation emerged, the Llorente-Gento dedicated to the world of sports. José Luis and Toñín, the two oldest, became very visible in the world of basketball while Paco and Julio Llorente opted for football. A fourth generation of athletes in the Llorente-Gento family keeps the flame alive with Marcos Llorente, current Real Madrid first team player

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Two Escobars
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

d/s Earth under X-ray (Seattle earthquake)
programme.desc: An X-ray survey of the Earth's surface revealed a huge anomaly 80 miles off the northwest Pacific coast. For more than 300 years, the pressure in this anomaly has been gradually increasing. If it reaches certain levels, it could cause a mega-earthquake and accompanying tsunami that could devastate a region called Cascadia, home to almost 15 million people. Scientists are racing to predict how bad the destruction will be when this Big Bang occurs. Dir.: Ian A. Hunt, Nick Tanner. USA

programme.title: d/s Earth under X-ray (Atlantic Coast Killer)
programme.desc: X-ray examination of the Earth's surface shows that the Atlantic island of La Palma has already been broken several times as a result of giant landslides. Another landslide of this magnitude could very well cause a tsunami powerful enough to reach and destroy the East Coast of the United States. Dir.: Ian A. Hunt, Nick Tanner. USA

programme.title: d/s Earth under X-ray (Apocalypse: Volcanoes)
programme.desc: X-ray surveys of the Earth's surface reveal that the largest volcano on the planet lies beneath Yellowstone National Park. It has already erupted many times with such force that it plunged the entire earth into a volcanic winter. No one living today has ever witnessed such a catastrophic eruption, but now scientists are feverishly trying to figure out what could trigger the next eruption of this volcano, how many warnings we will receive about this event. Dir.: Ian A. Hunt, Nick Tanner. USA

programme.title: d/f A look from the inside: Megatornado

Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: d/s Lost Secrets of the Bible with Albert Lean (Lost Cities of the Old Testament)
programme.desc: Could historical events described in the Old Testament, such as the Jewish crossing of the Red Sea and the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, really happen? Researcher Albert Lin, using the most modern equipment, is trying to unravel these secrets that have been hidden from us under the surface of the earth for thousands of years. He will visit the sites of supposed ancient cataclysms and find lost cities whose fate was described in some of the most famous stories of the Bible. USA

programme.title: d/f Ötzi: Murder in the Ice
programme.desc: As the earth warms, rapidly melting glaciers reveal long-forgotten relics and free the corpses of long-dead people from their icy tombs. Perhaps the most famous find of this kind is the ice mummy of Ötzi, a man who apparently froze to death on a mountain pass almost 5,000 years ago. Who was this man who lived almost a thousand years before the first pyramids appeared, and why his life ended so tragically. USA, Greece

programme.title: Africa's Hunters: The Hot Springs Pack (S2E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S2, Ep5
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S2, Ep5 «Africa's Hunters»…Meet a close-knit family of wild dogs who work together to raise pups and hunt enough food to feed the whole pack. While their well-coordinated hunts are successful, the wet season brings challenges when some of the team strikes out on their ownLarge carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's HuntersDirector: Hannah Hoare

programme.title: Brazil Untamed: Jaguar Den (S1E4). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep4 «Brazil Untamed»…Track a young jaguar as he practises hunting the way his mother taught him to. Watch him take on a caiman, who tests the inexperienced cat's skills with quick moves and surprising power. Then follow the jaguar mother on her prowl for a new mateThe mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birdsDirector: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue: How To Catch A Lizard (S2E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2022. S2, Ep1
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2022. Later, chase a treed rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizardMalawi is a small African country that has made a big push to protect its wildlife. Leading the effort is American veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb and her colleagues at the country's only animal rescue center, where injured and abandoned creatures are saved and rehabilitated. This six-part series follows the dedicated team as they care for a variety of patients, including vervet monkeys, bulbuls, baboons, hedgehogs, and many more, often working with limited resources and in dangerous conditions as they prepare the animals to return to the wildDirector: Andie ClareCast: Helen Baxendale, Dr. Charlotte Bentley, Amanda Salb

programme.desc: 2021 г. Год: 2021. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2021. S1, Ep2 «Battle of the Alphas»…Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kindFrom turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head with their own kind, in Battle of the AlphasDirector: Karen McCairleyCast: Mark Clermont

programme.title: Rooted: The Hollow Heart (S1E5). Documentary about nature. Saudi Arabia, 2017. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Saudo Arabija. Год: 2017. S1, Ep5 «Rooted»…Located on the Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe, this 800-year-old baobab is a remarkable tree containing its own ecosystem. Capable of withstanding extreme drought by storing water in its hollow trunk, it draws a multitude of wildlife, from elephants who strip its bark in search of food, to vultures that nest on its branches. Remarkably, it also has another gift: a velvety fruit packed with an astonishing cocktail of nutrients. To witness the baobab is to be awed by the natural forces that produced itDocumentary series examining the staggering wildlife activity on five of Africa's most iconic trees. Standing tall in often startlingly harsh environments, to survive as a tree in Africa requires much cunning. From the baobab's ability to store water, to the tricks of the sausage tree when seducing pollinators, this compelling series explores the thriving activity of each deeply rooted species, where birds, insects and other animals utilise their extraordinary featuresDirector: Dereck Joubert, Beverly JoubertCast: Fiona Ramsay

programme.title: Land of Gremlins: Lemur Spirit (S1E1). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1 «Land of Gremlins»…Follow a family of indris, some of the world's largest lemurs, on their daily quest through the rainforest to find food and escape predators. See how these endangered primates survive against all odds in a rapidly shrinking habitatLand of Gremlins is an amazing documentary about the island of Madagascar with its one-of-a-kind fauna. It has some of the rarest and most fascinating creatures on Earth. Have a look at the world's oldest island with a unique primitive ecosystem, its 70% of animals are found nowhere else. Explore the rich history of Madagascar's evolution and see how its various animals adapt to the current environment and what is their life like in the wild paradise nowadaysDirector: Claudio Velasquez-Rojas

programme.title: Into the Wild India: Growing Up Gibbon (S1E1) (Into the Wild: India). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2018. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2018. S1, Ep1 «Into the Wild: India»…Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Indian Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the treesExploring the wonderful wildlife of India and its diverse habitats and landscapes that are a home to many amazing species. The programme take the viewers to different parts of India, from the tundra and dessert to the rainforest and jungle, to showcase the animals which inhabit them. Each episode focuses on a specific species, looking into their ways of life and survival in these unique areas. This includes magnificent creatures like gibbons, Bengal tigers, sloth bears and many moreDirector: Joanne Ashman

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Science. 3 s.
programme.desc: What is behind the behavior of the most dangerous animals on the planet - lions, sharks, brown bears and rhinoceroses? The series explores their rare behaviors, unexpected hunting strategies, and hidden adaptation mechanisms. Through observation and scientific data, it is revealed how these animals survive in extreme conditions. USA

programme.title: d/f Wild Land (Cantabrian bear)
programme.desc: The mysterious lands of southern Europe reveal a world where nature retains its original strength and diversity. In these harsh and picturesque landscapes, a variety of inhabitants coexist: the cautious lynx, the majestic imperial eagle, the mighty bear, the swift kingfisher, the mountain goat and the cautious wolf. Spain

programme.title: d/f Savage Land (Iberian wolf)
programme.desc: The mysterious lands of southern Europe reveal a world where nature retains its original strength and diversity. In these harsh and picturesque landscapes, a variety of inhabitants coexist: the cautious lynx, the majestic imperial eagle, the mighty bear, the swift kingfisher, the mountain goat and the cautious wolf. Spain

programme.title: d/f Hunters of the Mediterranean Sea
programme.desc: In the world of wildlife, every living creature is not just part of an ecosystem, but also a participant in a brutal struggle for survival. This documentary takes us into the hunting strategies of Europe's most dangerous predators, from wild wolves to majestic eagles. We will also see how victims of predators invent their own tactics to escape. Spain

programme.title: d/s Clean Water Gardens (North America)
programme.desc: Water is a force of nature that shapes the behavior of animals and opens up new facets of survival and harmony on all continents of the Earth. In Antarctica, this element is concentrated in glaciers, in Latin America it fills rivers and jungles, in Africa it ensures the existence of savannas, and in Asia it becomes a decisive factor in conditions of natural contrasts. Spain

programme.title: d/f Algeria from a bird's eye view. 2 s.
programme.desc: We return under the watchful eye of director Yann Arthus-Bertrand to see the lesser-known but richly undulating landscape of Algeria, bordering eastern Morocco. We follow the daily lives of people in all its remote corners. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand, Yazid Tizi. Ved.: Jalil Lesper. France, Algeria

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Science. 4 s.
programme.desc: What is behind the behavior of the most dangerous animals on the planet - lions, sharks, brown bears and rhinoceroses? The series explores their rare behaviors, unexpected hunting strategies, and hidden adaptation mechanisms. Through observation and scientific data, it is revealed how these animals survive in extreme conditions. USA

programme.title: d/f Menorca. Biosphere Reserve
programme.desc: Menorca, one of the most picturesque islands of the Balearic archipelago, was declared a biosphere reserve in 1993, joining an elite club of just a few hundred members worldwide. The status of a biosphere reserve highlights the uniqueness of the island's ecosystem and the diversity of its natural resources, including magnificent beaches, picturesque coves and green hills rich in fauna and flora.

programme.title: d/f Wild Canary Islands
programme.desc: The Canary Islands are a unique archipelago surrounded by the azure waters of the Atlantic Ocean. All its islands are of volcanic origin, and each is different from the other. We will take an exciting journey to get acquainted with an unknown world in which a harsh volcanic landscape, reminiscent of an alien landscape, and relict laurels coexist; desert dunes and fragrant pine forests. Due to its isolation and climate, the Canary Islands are a unique nature reserve, most of which are endemic plants and animals that cannot be found anywhere else. Dir.: Juan Antonio, Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/f Phantom Killers
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in a world where every move can be your last, and the enemy is invisible to the eye. Spanish researchers are on the trail of ghostly predators to uncover their secrets and show how these creatures are changing the ecosystem. Unexpected discoveries, unique footage and a tense atmosphere - all this awaits viewers in a new documentary investigation. Spain

programme.title: d/s Force of nature (Survive day and night)
programme.desc: The change of day and night is like the cycle of life. In the jungles of Southern China, animals fight for survival. The Orchid Mantis is a genius at camouflage and a cold-blooded killer. In the dark, a young fishing cat stalks its prey. China

programme.title: d/s Strange creatures of the oceans (On the rocks)
programme.desc: In this episode we explore the harsh world of rocky shores and underwater cliffs. Spain

programme.title: d/f Caracals: Society of Lonely Cats
programme.desc: In the savannahs of South Africa, an inexperienced female caracal faces challenges to survival. After several failures, she decides to go on a long journey to the south. On her journey, the predator reaches the suburbs of Cape Town, where her life takes a new turn and she faces the opportunities and threats of a new world.

programme.title: d/f Coral oasis of the Tuamotu island
programme.desc: Tuamotu are the “distant islands” of Tahiti, lost in the middle of the ocean, far from the noisy world and trade routes. This secluded archipelago is home to an amazingly rich environment: coral reefs, rare birds and marine animals that are still struggling to withstand the onslaught of the modern world. France

programme.title: d/f Kingdom of Mount Manaslu
programme.desc: Nepal's Manaslu region, the heart of the Himalayas, is a natural pearl between heaven and earth. Here man and nature have coexisted since time immemorial. People and animals have learned to adapt and survive in the most extreme conditions. These valleys - once secluded - are increasingly opening up to the outside world, and local communities are trying to control tourist flows and maintain their traditional way of life while adapting to modernity. France

programme.title: d/f Lion Queens: in the fight for survival
programme.desc: A drought strikes in the heart of the African savannah, and the lives of the lionesses change forever. Pursued by elephants and driven out by buffaloes, they lose access to water and their usual prey. Now every hunt is a risk, and every day is a struggle for survival and protection of your cubs. In these extreme conditions, the amazing strength, cohesion and courage of lionesses are revealed. Their story is a tale of motherhood, leadership and the tireless struggle to preserve the pride, where not only their own lives are at stake, but also the future of the entire family

programme.title: d/s Birds: masters of the elements (Element of earth)
programme.desc: Birds live in the harshest corners of the planet - from the crater of a volcano to the depths of the sea. The series reveals the unique connection between birds and the four natural elements: air, water, earth and fire. They can withstand winds, overcome oceans, and get food in extreme conditions. But along with nature, they also have to adapt to human influence - the fifth element that they are encountering more and more often. Spain

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries (Mantises)
programme.desc: In this episode we delve into the exciting world of praying mantises. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Spain

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries (Rodents)
programme.desc: In this edition of the Field Notebook, we understand the mystique surrounding toads. These mysterious creatures hide many unknown secrets. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Spain

programme.title: Strange Animal Clinic. 5 s.
programme.desc: Dr. James performs surgery on a tiny zebra finch, Dr. Lucinda helps Froggy the frog, and Dr. Shane treats a Murray turtle with an abscess that has broken through its shell. Australia

programme.title: Land Without Land (Sharks of the Fiji Archipelago)
programme.desc: Dive into an adrenaline-filled journey into the depths of the South Pacific. Meet Fiji's apex predator. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Poland

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 9 p.
programme.desc: Join charming and energetic Sydney veterinarian Chris Brown and his team as they treat animals in the Bondi Beach area with great care and professionalism. From rescuing pets to caring for wild animals, they face new challenges every day. Watch as they save lives and create miracles, bringing light and hope to the animal world. Australia

programme.title: Land Without Land (Whales: Kingdom of Tonga)
programme.desc: Join us on a journey across the ocean to follow humpback whales on their annual migration to the warm waters of Wawa. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Poland

programme.title: d/f Marine Mammals: Champions of the Deep
programme.desc: How do marine mammals overcome incredible depths and pressures that are inaccessible to humans? Why are whales able to hold their breath for tens of minutes, while dolphins navigate in complete darkness? In this film, French researchers reveal the secrets of the unique adaptations that allow these animals to be true champions of the deep. You'll see rare footage of underwater life, learn about complex social relationships and unusual hunting methods, and learn about the latest scientific discoveries that are changing our understanding of life in the ocean. France

programme.title: d/s Underwater China. 1 p.
programme.desc: We invite you on an exciting journey under the waters of China! The project opens up amazing underwater worlds to viewers, hidden from the eyes of most people. We explore unique ecosystems where rare species of fish, shellfish and other sea creatures live. You will see how the life of underwater inhabitants changes depending on the time of year and climatic conditions, and learn how local residents care about the preservation of these fragile ecosystems

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
